sloka: विमानं पुष्पकं तत्तु सन्निवर्त्य मनोजवम् ।दीना त्रिजटया सीता लङ्कामेव प्रवेशिता ।। ६.४८.३५ ।।।।
transliteration: vimānaṁ puṣpakaṁ tattu sannivartya manojavam ।dīnā trijaṭayā sītā laṅkāmeva praveśitā ।। 6.48.35 ।।।।

translations.english: Then Trijata took Sita in the Pushpaka chariot endowed with the speed of mind and entered Lanka.
